direct_original_vs_slab_microbenchmark.scope: Preallocated resident original mode0 hotpath vs actual C frame slabs; identical allocation/copy and delayed-read workload.
limitations: Original allocator growth, seal/reclaim and imported slow paths are not executed; any attempted slow path aborts.
Original cleanup is synthetic final backing-owner release/free, not original game lifecycle cost.
Slab cleanup is actual C core close/retire and malloc/free callbacks; Wine heap and hook dispatch are not measured.
Original backing is prefaulted before allocation timing; slab refills and their first writes occur inside allocation timing.
Recent size sample frequencies are a bounded observed mix, not the full 104.8M-call distribution.
Reported timings are wall-clock microbenchmark throughput, not game CPU/frame or FPS.
Correctness includes all-byte delayed reads and a C++ exception cleanup test, not Windows SEH hook validation.

occluded_world_cpu_diagnostic.method: Thirty-second CPU windows in one copied-world session, OFF/16/OFF/16/OFF; submitted frame IDs from completed Metal callbacks, including zero presentation timestamps.
limitations: Visibility and pause state are not independently verified.
OFF includes experimental hooks and counters.
This experiment cannot establish normal foreground gameplay improvement.
Camera and unchanged gameplay workload were not independently verified.
Lifecycle counter deltas include warm-up and callback draining and cannot be divided by the 30-second submission count.
Cumulative long session included mostly OFF time; totals are not specific to measured ON windows.
Thread slots exhausted; per-thread totals have incomplete coverage. Atomic lifecycle counts retired all 957 registered scopes with zero quarantine or reserved bytes.

foreground_frame_slab_comparison.method: One loaded copied-world session, OFF/16/OFF/16/OFF, 30-second nominal CPU windows. Binding observer disarmed throughout. Foreground process sampled every second; distinct same-layer positive Metal presentation timestamps. Camera visually checked before and after; no input during timing.
foreground_frame_slab_comparison.desktop_control: Recovered after user restarted Codex. World entry, visual checks and normal save/quit performed through restored native control.
limitations: Two candidate windows in one stationary scene; no statistical generalization to other worlds or motion.
Daylight was not frozen in this sequence. Final OFF CPU declined; interpolation only corrects smooth drift.
OFF retains experimental frame hooks/counters and disarmed binding wrappers. Separate normal-module comparison is required.
CPU time sums all game/server threads; it is not elapsed frame time. No visual corruption observed, but screenshots do not establish exhaustive gameplay correctness.
Lifecycle totals cover the whole launch and cannot be divided by benchmark frame counts.

normal_module_frame_slab_comparison.method: Normal A / pure frame-slab B / normal C across three private lab launches. Daylight frozen at noon; same copied world and saved position; explicit yaw 113/pitch 4 after every reload. Camera verified visually before/after. No input during captures. Foreground sampled each second; distinct positive same-layer Metal presentation timestamps. At least 30s scene warm-up plus 5s settle; nominal 30s measurement windows.
normal_module_frame_slab_comparison.conclusion: The slab candidate repeatedly reduced CPU work in this fixed scene; the exact normal-runtime gain needs tighter replication. No demonstrated FPS improvement.
limitations: Two candidate windows in one launch, bracketed by two normal launches; no randomized independent replicate launches.
Normal CPU/frame varied from 61.89 to 72.29 ms. Later normal windows remained higher despite further warm-up; do not infer a precise causal percentage or explain the entire difference as loading.
World simulation continues even with fixed daylight. Thermal state was not recorded; background OS activity and wineserver CPU varied.
All runs retain the same presentation tracing and 10 ms pacing. No unpaced throughput or power/thermal comparison was performed.
CPU time sums game and private wineserver threads, not elapsed frame duration. Footprints also varied across launches; no memory-reduction claim.
Visual spot checks, clean saves/exits and allocation retirement do not establish exhaustive gameplay or long-session correctness.
